tools.name: quaderno_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Quaderno API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path is taken after /api (e.g. "/tax_ids", "/evidence"). Quaderno API: GET {path}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_list_webhooks · Private data: quaderno_ping, quaderno_calculate_tax, quaderno_list_invoices, quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_get_contact, quaderno_list_credit_notes, quaderno_create_contact, quaderno_update_contact, quaderno_create_invoice, quaderno_create_transaction · Public sink: quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_create_contact, quaderno_create_item, quaderno_create_invoice, quaderno_create_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_list_webhooks · Private data: quaderno_ping, quaderno_calculate_tax, quaderno_list_invoices, quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_get_contact, quaderno_list_credit_notes, quaderno_create_contact, quaderno_update_contact, quaderno_create_invoice, quaderno_create_transaction · Public sink: quaderno_list_contacts, quaderno_create_contact, quaderno_create_item, quaderno_create_invoice, quaderno_create_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
